main_idea: On-policy distillation improves GDPval results across two model families.
ideas: Nemotron gains a +20.9% net win-loss margin.
Qwen gains a +21.4% net win-loss margin.
Student generations provide the distillation training signal.
summary: The results are clear, but the long subtitle and large process diagram compete with the main finding.
